headline: Biden’s China Policy? A Balancing Act for a Toxic Relationship
snippet: As president, Joe Biden will face deep dilemmas, and a lot of unfinished business, stemming from President Trump’s multiyear onslaught against China.

headline: At-Home Covid Tests and Other Powers of a Tech Billionaire
snippet: Chamath Palihapitiya made his fortune with bold predictions and bets on the future. That wealth gives him influence well beyond Silicon Valley — but should it?

headline: Daily Report: IBM Embraces Its Inner Designer
snippet: Phil Gilbert, head of design at IBM, is trying to get the technology giant to embrace a new concept that could potentially help the company, which has seen two years of declining revenue, rethink its approach.

headline: A Robot That Coos, Cries and Knows When It Needs a New Diaper
snippet: My Real Baby, animatronic doll priced at $100, was developed by iRobot working with Hasbro; Dr Rodney Brooks, chairman of iRobot, talks about My Real Baby doll and what it can do; photo (M)
